summary: Batch #33 — Trusted Helpers PHASE 4 (Care Team Photos + Trip ETA Alerts + Shift Reminders + pickup create bugfix). BACKEND: 21/21 pytest pass in ~7s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_batch33_trusted_helpers_phase4.py). Covered end-to-end: (1) BUGFIX regression — POST /api/helpers/{helper_id}/tasks with category=pickup + pickup_from + pickup_to + dest_lat + dest_lng now PERSISTS all fields (verified in the immediate response AND on read-back via GET /api/helpers/{id}/tasks). Second variant (no dest_lat/dest_lng) still persists pickup_from/pickup_to with dest_lat/dest_lng=null. Both created tasks cleaned up. (2) TRIP ETA — after PATCH /api/helper-tasks/{id} {dest_lat:28.6,dest_lng:77.2} and POST /helper/tasks/{id}/trip stage=en_route: FAR point (28.70,77.20) ~11 km → 200 with eta_min>=4 and ZERO new 📍 parent notifications; NEAR point (28.61,77.20) ~1.1 km → 200 with eta_min AND EXACTLY ONE new 📍 parent notification (verified by scanning GET /api/notifications items for emoji=='📍'); a REPEAT near point (28.605,77.202) → 200 with NO 2nd 📍 alert (trip.eta_alerted guard). Also asserted db.helper_task_completions.trip.eta_alerted==True post-alert. Location BEFORE Start Trip returns 400 with detail mentioning 'start'/'trip' (verified after wiping today's completion row for the pickup task). (3) SHIFT REMINDER — /helper/dashboard returns shift={start_time,end_time,today,on_duty,minutes_until,reminder} with correct types. PATCH /api/helpers/{id} access.start_time = now+30 min → shift.reminder=true, minutes_until in [25,35]; PATCH to now+3 h → reminder=false, minutes_until either None (wrapped past midnight) or >60. Original access restored to now+40 min so the frontend banner test continues to work. (4) CARE TEAM PHOTOS — parent POST /api/care-team/chat {photo_url} → 200; helper GET sees photo_url. Helper POST /helper/care-team {photo_url} → 200; parent GET sees photo_url. Text-only still works. Empty message (no text, no photo_url) → 400 on both endpoints. Isolation preserved: a care-team photo NEVER appears in /helpers/{id}/chat (db.helper_messages) nor in the family chat messages. (5) SECURITY regression sanity — parent token → 401 on /helper/care-team, /helper/medical, /helper/dashboard; helper token → 401 on /care-team/chat, /care-team/unread, /helpers/{id}/ratings; helper w/o 'chat' perm → 403 on GET+POST /helper/care-team; /helper/medical still returns ONLY safe fields (blob assertion for 'medication'/'conditions'/'insurance'/'policy'); paused helper is 401/403 on /helper/care-team, /helper/medical, /helper/dashboard, /helper/tasks/*/location. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): HELPER PORTAL (sunita/1234) — ALL 6 Phase-4 testIDs render and display correctly: portal-praise (banner), portal-shift (banner text: '⏰ Your shift starts at 21:41 — about 39 min to go. Get ready!' — reminder true at ~40-min-ahead as expected), portal-chat-btn, portal-careteam-btn, portal-handover-btn, portal-medical-btn. Tapping portal-careteam-btn opens the group chat screen; careteam-input, careteam-send, careteam-attach all present. Tapping careteam-attach opens the attach sheet: careteam-camera + careteam-gallery both render (web picker denies access — expected — but the sheet mounts without crashing). Pickup task on portal after Start Trip: trip-live-* toggle count=1 (mounts without crash). No React-Native red screen, no new expo-notifications errors beyond the pre-existing web-support warning. PARENT UI (partial) — code-inspection confirms testIDs are wired: dropoff-<task_id> in /helper/[id].tsx:334 (renders per pickup task; label reads 'Arrival alerts on · tap to update' when dest is set), care-team-cta in /(tabs)/family.tsx:295, and CareTeamChatView renders careteam-attach/camera/gallery for parents too. Parent-side UI walk-through could NOT be re-verified via Playwright automation this run — the Expo web app persists auth in a non-localStorage store (AsyncStorage IndexedDB) and the automation harness's storage-clear + UI-fill sequence returned 401 on subsequent nav (session drops after page reload). This is a testing-harness limitation, NOT an app bug (iteration_31 successfully tested the same parent flow before storage-clear was added). Backend fully validates every parent-side data path (care-team round-trip, dropoff pin/PATCH on task, notifications). Verdict: Batch #33 (Phase 4) fully passes end-to-end on backend + helper-portal frontend. No new bugs; no deprecated Expo packages introduced by Phase-4 files.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: after this run, today's pickup task for Sunita has trip.status='en_route' with trip.eta_alerted=true (fired once during the ETA pytest). Wipe today's completion row before re-testing the 'FAR then NEAR' sequence: db.helper_task_completions.delete_many({helper_id:'help_c77a0a30120545bb', date: '<today UTC YYYY-MM-DD>'}). critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6467-6489 create_helper_task now correctly persists pickup_from/pickup_to (str().strip() or None) AND dest_lat/dest_lng — bugfix verified by immediate response + GET read-back. clean() strips _id. Good.

server.py:7002-7032 helper_task_location — one-time ETA guard implemented via trip.eta_alerted flag set atomically together with trip.eta_min. The distance is only computed if dest_lat/dest_lng present, and only fires when trip.status ∈ {'en_route','picked_up'} AND !eta_alerted AND dist<=ETA_ALERT_M(2000). Cleanly idempotent. Notification message uses the 📍 emoji and pickup_to as destination label + first-name of assigned member. Well-designed.

server.py:6993-6999 _haversine_m — textbook formula, in metres. eta_min = max(1, round(dist/500)) ⇒ ~30 km/h walking-pace fallback; acceptable for a coarse ETA hint. If the app wants precision it can override the divisor later.

server.py:6113-6142 _shift_status correctly clamps reminder to 0<=minutes_until<=60 and returns None minutes_until when today's start has already passed OR today is not a working day. UTC comparison consistent with _within_hours. Verified end-to-end at 30-min and 3h ahead.

server.py:6499-6508 patch_helper_task allows dest_lat/dest_lng updates and returns fresh task — used by the parent 'dropoff-<task_id>' pin capture button (frontend uses PATCH with {dest_lat,dest_lng}).

server.py:6611-6615 care_msg_public passes through photo_url — care-team endpoints support both text-only, photo-only and mixed messages. Empty (no text + no photo_url) is rejected with 400 on both /care-team/chat and /helper/care-team. Isolation from db.messages (family chat) and db.helper_messages (1:1) is guaranteed by using a dedicated db.care_team_messages collection; regression test confirms photo doesn't leak.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Phase-4 backend routes (server.py): POST /api/helpers/{helper_id}/tasks now persists pickup_from/pickup_to + dest_lat/dest_lng on CREATE (bugfix around line 6483-6485). PATCH /api/helper-tasks/{id} accepts dest_lat/dest_lng too. POST /api/helper/tasks/{task_id}/location (line 7002) is the driver's live-GPS ping; requires prior POST /api/helper/tasks/{id}/trip stage=en_route to have created today's completion row, else 400 'Start the trip before sharing your location'. Fires ONE 📍 parent notification per trip when dist<=2000m from dest AND trip.eta_alerted is falsy — the alert flag is $set on the same completion row and gates subsequent near pings. helper_dashboard returns shift={start_time,end_time,today,on_duty,minutes_until,reminder} via _shift_status (line 6113); reminder=true iff 0<=minutes_until<=60 UTC. Care Team photo pass-through is in care_msg_public (line 6611). 2) FRONTEND testIDs verified: helper-portal — portal-praise, portal-shift, portal-chat-btn, portal-careteam-btn, portal-handover-btn, portal-medical-btn (/app/frontend/app/helper-portal/index.tsx around lines 245-418); trip-live-<task_id> on pickup tasks after Start Trip. Care-team: careteam-attach/careteam-camera/careteam-gallery/careteam-input/careteam-send/ctmsg-<id> (/app/frontend/src/components/CareTeamChatView.tsx). Parent: dropoff-<task_id> (/app/frontend/app/helper/[id].tsx:334), care-team-cta (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/family.tsx:295). 3) ETA repeatability: to re-test the FAR→NEAR→REPEAT sequence, wipe today's completion row for the pickup task (db.helper_task_completions.delete_many({helper_id, task_id, date})) — the pytest fixture _reset_today_pickup_completion does exactly this. 4) Parent UI in Playwright: use direct API login + set localStorage token in a persistent context, OR fill inputs via `nativeInputValueSetter` + dispatch 'input' event (React Native web inputs on this Expo build ignore .fill()/keyboard.type without a proper input event) — see /app/test_reports/iteration_31.json where the parent flow worked with a fresh (non-storage-cleared) session. 5) Notification detection: /api/notifications returns {items:[{emoji,title,subtitle,...}], unread_count, last_read}. Look for emoji=='📍' OR title contains 'min from' to count ETA alerts. 6) Web geolocation/camera cannot be exercised by Playwright — the app is coded to gracefully handle prompt-denied on Android/iOS/web, and the network round-trip (POST /helper/tasks/{id}/location with a hard-coded lat/lng) is what backend tests validate. 7) Care team photo isolation: the collection is db.care_team_messages ONLY — a photo posted there NEVER appears in db.messages (family chat) or db.helper_messages (1:1 helper chat). Confirmed by markers.
